subject: Onboarding kickoff: edge proxy, service identities & IP allowlist policy
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Sun <ava.sun@brightwavehealth.com>, it-ops@brightwavehealth.com
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding kickoff: edge proxy, service identities & IP allowlist policy

Hi Ava / BrightWave IT team —

Thanks for choosing Redwood. I'm Logan on the CS side and I'll shepherd the access-control portion of the implementation. Quick kickoff note and asks so the tech sync is focused:

Proposed agenda (30–45 min):
- Confirm SSO / SAML endpoints & metadata (IdP entity ID, ACS URL)
- SCIM attributes and user->role mapping (groups, role_claim)
- IP allowlist constraints and preferred cutover approach (static ranges vs jump-host)
- Service account pattern and rotation (naming conventions and token lifetime expectations)
- Audit log & retention expectations for token issuance / admin events

Immediate asks (please share before the sync if available):
1) SAML metadata file or IdP metadata URL
2) SCIM attribute list you plan to provision (email, displayName, groups, manager)
3) IP CIDR ranges for staging and prod allowlists (we can also accept a CSV)
4) Any policy or controls doc that dictates service account naming/rotation in your org

Attachments I pushed to this thread: the BrightWave questionnaire (we filled a couple fields based on discovery) and a template CSV for IP ranges.

Suggested timeline: technical sync this week (we're available Wed/Thu 10–1 PT), dev verification next week, cutover the week after pending smoke tests. If you prefer a different cadence tell us and we'll adapt.

Thanks — looking forward to the sync.

—
Logan Wright
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: brightwave-sso-scim-questionnaire.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Ava Sun <ava.sun@brightwavehealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: John Park <john.park@brightwavehealth.com>, it-ops@brightwavehealth.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding kickoff: edge proxy, service identities & IP allowlist policy

Hi Logan / Priyom —

Appreciate the agenda. A few notes from our side before we sync: 

- We run Okta as our IdP; metadata URL will be available. I will send the metadata and a short Okta integration guide.
- SCIM: we plan to sync email, givenName, familyName, groups and a custom attribute "bw_role" used by our RBAC. Can Redwood map bw_role -> product role?
- IP allowlist: we cannot add broad ranges to prod. We'll provide a CSV with our egress NAT ranges for staging and prod. Staging ranges attached.
- Service accounts: security requires rotation every 30 days; ideally we'd use short-lived certs or rotate keys via Vault. Can Redwood support short-lived credentials / integrate with our KMS?
- Audit logs: retention 13 months on our side; for anything Redwood emits during provisioning we need event-level detail (timestamp, actor, action).

I'll loop John (network/security) for the IP list. He attached the staging ranges.

Availability: Thursday 11/4 at 11:00 PT works for us for a technical sync.

Thanks,
Ava
Director, IT Ops — BrightWave Health
[Attachment: brightwave-network-range.csv (text/csv)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Sun <ava.sun@brightwavehealth.com>, John Park <john.park@brightwavehealth.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding kickoff: edge proxy, service identities & IP allowlist policy

Ava / John —

Thanks for the quick reply and the staging CIDRs — helpful. Short plan from our infra/engineering side and answers to your questions below.

High-level plan (technical items we will own vs you):
- Redwood will host an edge proxy (redwood-edge) in the same region; production allowlist can point to our edge IPs when you want us to take traffic (this avoids adding many Redwood backend ranges to your prod allowlist). If you need direct-to-inference nodes we can provide the full CIDR list but prefer the edge approach for maintainability.
- SSO/SAML: Redwood supports Okta. We can consume IdP metadata URL; we will also provide SP metadata (ACS URL, SP entity) for your team to configure.
- SCIM: we can map a custom attribute bw_role -> product_role via a simple mapping table. We'll include an example mapping sheet in the Drive link.
- Service accounts: recommended naming: svc-brightwave-redwood-{env}-{purpose} (e.g., svc-brightwave-redwood-prod-ingest). For rotation, we support both:
   * long-lived keys rotated by customer-managed Vault/KMS (preferred for strict rotation policies), or
   * short-lived tokens issued by Redwood with a TTL (we currently support TTLs down to 1 hour).
  If you want Vault-based rotation, we can accept signed certs or OIDC flow for retrieval.
- Audit logs: Redwood can emit provisioning and admin events to your secure S3 bucket or push to a log webhook; default retention on our side is 18 months, we can align exports to your 13-month requirement for ingestion into your SIEM.

Deliverables I attached: Redwood service account guidance PDF and a mapping template. Fast asks for our Thursday sync (11/4 11:00 PT):
1) Okta metadata URL (or metadata XML)
2) Confirm whether you prefer edge-proxy model or full backend allowlist for prod
3) Which rotation model for service accounts (Vault/KMS vs Redwood TTL)

I'll create a short mutual-action checklist and share prior to the call.

—
Priyom Das
Technical Customer Success — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-service-account-guidance.pdf (application/pdf)]
